name: Test sieu am
xmlText: <xml xmlns="https://developers.google.com/blockly/xml"><block type="yolobit_basic_forever" id="main" x="20" y="20"><statement name="ONSTART"></statement><statement name="FOREVER"></statement></block></xml>
python:
from yolobit import *
import time
from aiot_lcd1602 import LCD1602
from aiot_hcsr04 import HCSR04

aiot_lcd1602 = LCD1602()
aiot_ultrasonic = None
khoang_cach = 999

def hien_kc():
  global khoang_cach
  if aiot_ultrasonic is None:
    khoang_cach = 999
  else:
    try:
      khoang_cach = int(aiot_ultrasonic.distance_cm())
    except OSError:
      khoang_cach = 999
  aiot_lcd1602.clear()
  aiot_lcd1602.move_to(0, 0)
  aiot_lcd1602.putstr('Khoang cach')
  aiot_lcd1602.move_to(0, 1)
  aiot_lcd1602.putstr(str(khoang_cach) + ' cm')

aiot_lcd1602.clear()
aiot_lcd1602.move_to(0, 0)
aiot_lcd1602.putstr('Test sieu am')
aiot_lcd1602.move_to(0, 1)
aiot_lcd1602.putstr('P10/P13')
time.sleep_ms(800)
aiot_ultrasonic = HCSR04(trigger_pin=pin10.pin, echo_pin=pin13.pin)
time.sleep_ms(500)

while True:
  hien_kc()
  time.sleep_ms(200)
